# Cncf Ibm Cloud Kubernetes Service Reviewer

Review IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service using its official documentation and repository in the Platform / Certified Kubernetes - Hosted category. IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service is a managed offering to create your own Kubernetes cluster of compute hosts to deploy and manage containerized apps on IBM Cloud.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
